sys_script.description: Thin adapter: when a NEW audit row lands for a field on an extraction that is ALREADY Applied (confirmed), and the corrected column is on the GUIDELINE allow-list, delegate to UWTriggerReasonResolver (isManualCorrection) + UWGuidelineVersionService to create the next uw_guideline_version. Manual corrections made BEFORE confirmation are covered by "UW Guideline trigger on extraction confirmed" instead - this rule only fires for edits AFTER confirmation.
sys_script.name: UW Guideline trigger on manual correction
